trap.label: argue that
trap.wrong: She argued about that the age should be lowered.
trap.right: She argued that the age should be lowered.
trap.why: Em português “argumentou sobre que” leva preposição. Em inglês, argue that + oração, sem about.

fix.wrong: The winner team argued that turnout was low.
fix.right: The winning team argued that turnout was low.

fix.wrong: She said me that the vote was fair.
fix.right: She told me that the vote was fair.

fix.wrong: They countered, that the claim was weak.
fix.right: They countered that the claim was weak.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com argued that: “She said, ‘Youth turnout is low.’”
rewrite.answer: She argued that youth turnout was low.
rewrite.why: Aceita-se: She argued that youth turnout was low.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com countered that: “He replied that the claim was weak.”
rewrite.answer: He countered that the claim was weak.
